evaluation_statement: Performance against the ERA5-Land reanalysis proxy — not observation.
spatial_statement: Results are exploratory: 11 areas (6 regions) and 110 ERA5-Land cells from one 3-year window; they do not establish observational accuracy or deployment readiness.
target_framing: Target: ERA5-Land reanalysis proxy. Coarse predictor: ERA5 reanalysis. Not observational validation.

karwar_exception.note: KARWAR EXCEPTION: the frozen selection required >= 6 ERA5-Land cells. The Stage 4C land/sea audit found E5L_14.90N_74.10E is sea; Majali (220655) and Mudgeri (220657) were excluded as NON_LAND_TARGET_CELL with no neighbouring-cell substitution. Karwar is evaluated with 14 Panchayats and 5 cells, BELOW the original >= 6-cell criterion.

district.reason: the selection allows one Taluka Panchayat per Zila Panchayat, so each district holdout removes exactly one selected Taluka Panchayat

temporal_split.note: Identical to Phase 2D; applied inside every spatial fold.

splits.yelandur_role: frozen reference: never in any training set; evaluated as an extra reference region in every fold

model_configuration.A1_bilinear: ERA5 bilinear value of the target variable; no training
model_configuration.A2_nearest: ERA5 nearest-point value of the target variable; no training

district_holdout.reason: frozen design: one selected area per district; per-row district fold IDs equal area fold IDs (verified), so results are identical and not re-computed

cellblock_diagnostic.label: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — test and training cells can share an area; not a geographic generalization estimate

yelandur_reference.role: frozen reference: never in any training set; evaluated as an extra reference region in every fold
yelandur_reference.population: Phase 2D COMPLETE GPs (Agara PARTIAL and Mamballi UNAVAILABLE excluded), 2023 test period

analysis.note: Spearman correlations over 11 areas / 110 cells are exploratory, not significance tests.
